data.name: Shivkant
data.gender_notes: Shivkant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shivkant is a name derived from the word 'Shiva' which means 'The God of Destruction and the Transformer'. Kant means 'Grace' or 'Power'. So, Shivkant means 'God Shiva's Grace' or 'The Power of God Shiva'. The name Shivkant carries the meaning “God Shiva's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivkant usually hope their child will grow to embody god shiva's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivkant is a name that signifies the divine grace of Lord Shiva. It represents the power, strength, and courage of the deity. It is believed that a person named Shivkant will possess these qualities and will be blessed with the divine protection and guidance of Lord Shiva.
data.etymology: Shivkant belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Shiva's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivkant total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Shivkant is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and culture. Shiva is one of the three primary deities in Hinduism, and represents the destroyer, or the transformation aspect of the gods (along with Brahma, representing creation, and Vishnu, representing preservation). Shiva is also known as 'Nataraja', the lord of dance, and is revered for his ability to bring about change, and to help individuals transform their lives. The name 'Shivkant' honors this rich cultural and spiritual heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shivkant carries the profound promise of the 'Grace of God Shiva'. It implies the presence of the divine, and the support and blessings of the Lord Shiva in the individual's life. 'The Power of God Shiva' suggests the ability to overcome adversity, and to transform oneself through the grace and guidance of the divine. It is a reminder that even in the most difficult times, the individual is not alone, and that they have the support and power of God Shiva with them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivkant: One who is devoted to Lord Shiva (the embodiment of destruction and transformation), and aspires to attain his supreme consciousness and power within.
